T0677.title: Account Abstraction
T0677.definition: Account abstraction extends account validation and transaction execution from fixed protocol rules into programmable contract logic.
T0677.description: Account abstraction lets smart-contract wallets customize signature validation, batched calls, sponsored fees, session keys, and social recovery. ERC-4337 implements this model without changing Ethereum consensus through components such as UserOperation, EntryPoint, Bundler, and Paymaster, while introducing new attack surfaces in validation logic, fee sponsorship, and bundling infrastructure.
T0677.usageExample: An Account Abstraction wallet uses a Paymaster to sponsor gas and a session key that limits an application to pre-authorized operations.

references.title: EIP-4337: Account Abstraction Using Alt Mempool
